name: COACH CLASS
clue: The University of Kansas's first basketball coach posted a losing record there, though he had invented the game

name: RING LEADER
clue: Pierre de Coubertin said its five colors on a white field reproduced the colors of every nation's banner

name: OFF THE BOARDWALK
clue: Of the classic Monopoly board's colored properties, only the misspelled Marvin Gardens lies outside this New Jersey resort

name: HOLY BUBBLY
clue: Moët & Chandon's prestige cuvée honors this Benedictine monk, often but wrongly said to have invented champagne
